verdict.rationale: First-party docs say you can run the Convex backend on your own servers, and that self-hosted Convex runs the open-source backend with the same up-to-date code as the cloud service. The official GitHub repo adds that it works with Postgres, SQLite, RDS, Neon, Fly.io and similar infrastructure. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of self-hosted deployments, detailed operational docs in the pack (setup method, upgrades, dashboard parity)
